en.askTitle: Put in your own visas, savings and price range, and compare buying now with waiting for permanent residency
en.runTitle: Perth first home on 491 visas: buy now or wait for PR in 2028?

fields.label: Debts and monthly surplus
fields.placeholder: e.g. no debts, AUD 2,500 a month spare after living costs

fields.label: Property type
fields.value: 3-bedroom house in Perth's northern or south-eastern suburbs

en.template: Compare buying a Perth first home on {visa} with waiting for {milestone}. Use {savings}, {debts}, {price} and {type}. Separate purchase permission, duty/grant eligibility, upfront payment dates, lender risk fees and a retained reserve. Show a cautious baseline and genuinely qualifying alternatives, and flag what still needs professional confirmation. Ask before contacting anyone, applying or sharing personal data.

phases.title: Check foreign-buyer permission, WA duty and grants, lender policies and recent sales
phases.note: Federal and state rules, lender criteria and dated sale prices
phases.judgment: It caught a contradiction between sources. A broker said NAB lends to 491 holders, but NAB's own mortgage page excludes applicants who need foreign-investment approval, so the lender was not counted as an option for this couple.

phases.title: Build the buy-now versus wait comparison and the guide
phases.note: Upfront cost on each path, lender options, suburb examples and a timeline
phases.judgment: It kept the case for waiting honest. The guide's baseline shows $239,065 upfront if they buy on 491 versus $163,350 after PR, but it also adds the off-the-plan duty concession and one lender's conditional 95% option, and marks two of the four suburb examples as provisional because only two full listings could be read.

phases.title: Independent check of every figure, plus desktop and phone layout tests
phases.judgment: A separate colleague redid the arithmetic: 88 checks, zero mismatches. It also pushed back on wording, noting that one line described all sale examples as three-bedroom houses although one was unverified, and that property coverage was still thin.

workers: Compared which lenders accept 491 visa holders, their loan-to-value limits, insurance and rates, using the lenders' own documents
Found dated sold examples of 3-bedroom houses in northern and south-eastern Perth suburbs
Recomputed every dollar figure on its own and checked the guide's claims against the saved source pages

zh.askTitle: 填入你们自己的签证、存款和价格区间，比较现在就买和等拿到永居再买
zh.runTitle: 珀斯首套房，持 491 签证：现在买还是等 2028 年拿永居？

fields.label: 双方实际签证
fields.value: 双方都持技术类偏远地区（491）签证

fields.label: 永居获批节点
fields.value: 预计 2028 年左右拿到永居（191）

fields.label: 债务及每月结余
fields.placeholder: 例如：没有债务，扣除生活费后每月结余 2,500 澳元

fields.label: 房屋类型
fields.value: 珀斯北部或东南部的三卧室独立屋

zh.template: 请比较持{visa}购买珀斯首套房，与等待{milestone}的差别。使用{savings}、{debts}、{price}和{type}。分开列明购买许可、税费和补助资格、前期付款日期、贷款风险费及应急金。给出稳妥基准和真正符合条件的替代方案，标明仍需专业确认的事项。联系任何人、申请或分享个人信息前，先征得我同意。

phases.title: 查外国买家购房许可、西澳税费和补助、银行政策以及近期成交
phases.note: 联邦和州的规定、银行条件和有日期的成交价
phases.judgment: 它发现了来源之间的矛盾。中介说 NAB 肯接 491 签证持有人，但 NAB 自己的房贷页面把需要外国投资审批的申请人排除在外，所以没有把这家银行算作这对夫妻的选项。

phases.title: 做出“现在买”与“等永居”的对比，并写出指南
phases.note: 两条路的前期总花费、银行选项、各区成交例子和时间线
phases.judgment: 它没有为“等”这个结论加码。指南基准显示：持 491 现在买需要前期 239,065 澳元，拿永居后买是 163,350 澳元；同时也写入了期房印花税优惠和一家银行有条件的 95% 贷款选项，并把四个区的成交例子里只读到两个完整房源的情况如实标成“待确认”。

phases.title: 独立核对每个数字，并在电脑和手机上测试版面
phases.judgment: 另一位同事独立重算：88 项核对，零差异。它还对措辞提出异议：有一句把所有成交例子都说成三卧室独立屋，但其中一个并未核实；房产样本也仍然偏少。

workers: 查哪些银行接受 491 签证持有人，以及它们的贷款成数上限、保险和利率，依据银行自己的文件
找珀斯北部和东南部各区三卧室独立屋有日期的成交例子
独立重算每一笔金额，并对照保存的来源网页核对指南里的说法
